## Apps posting in rooms

| Method | Path | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/rooms/:id/apps` | Signed in | The apps posting in a room ("Apps posting here") and whether this server can be reached by them at all. In a team room or the everyone room: its owners and admins who are in it; in a 1:1 or a group chat: any of its members. A member without the right gets 403, anyone not in the room 404. |
| `POST` | `/api/rooms/:id/apps` | Signed in | Add an app (on the first "Copy address"): its secret address comes back (preset email: an email address, 409 room_email_off while the team has email off, 409 mail_not_connected without a mail service). `preset` (only with kind other, 400 otherwise) sets it up as a named service (Notion, Typeform, Tally, Jotform, Stripe, Shopify, Zendesk); it is fixed from then on. In a team room or the everyone room: its owners and admins who are in it; in a 1:1 or a group chat: any of its members. A member without the right gets 403, anyone not in the room 404. At most 10 per room (409 room_apps_full), 10 added per person and hour (429); 409 no_public_address without an internet address; 400 when the name is a person's in this team. Audited. |
| `GET` | `/api/rooms/:id/apps/:appId/address` | Signed in | Copy an app's address again (and a secret Trina made for it). In a team room or the everyone room: its owners and admins who are in it; in a 1:1 or a group chat: any of its members. A member without the right gets 403, anyone not in the room 404. |
| `PATCH` | `/api/rooms/:id/apps/:appId` | Signed in | Change an app's switches, Quiet or name. In a team room or the everyone room: its owners and admins who are in it; in a 1:1 or a group chat: any of its members. A member without the right gets 403, anyone not in the room 404. Audited. |
| `PUT` | `/api/rooms/:id/apps/:appId/secret` | Signed in | "Make it safer" / "Signing secret (optional)": make a secret (GitHub, Typeform, Tally), save the service's own (Sentry's Client Secret; Stripe's, Shopify's, Zendesk's, Toss Payments' or PortOne's signing secret, Channel Talk's webhook token; checked by its shape; Zendesk's public test secret is refused), or take the secret away. 400 no_signing for a service that cannot sign (plain Other, Google Forms, Notion, Jotform, Jira, HubSpot). Once a secret is saved, unsigned or wrong requests are refused (401). In a team room or the everyone room: its owners and admins who are in it; in a 1:1 or a group chat: any of its members. A member without the right gets 403, anyone not in the room 404. Audited (never the secret). |
| `POST` | `/api/rooms/:id/apps/:appId/rotate` | Signed in | "Get a new address": the old one stops working at once (an Email app: mail to the old address is refused from now on; 503 mail_unreachable when the mail service cannot be told, nothing changed). In a team room or the everyone room: its owners and admins who are in it; in a 1:1 or a group chat: any of its members. A member without the right gets 403, anyone not in the room 404. Audited. |
| `POST` | `/api/rooms/:id/apps/:appId/resume` | Signed in | "Resume now" after the day's cap paused an app: as many messages again today, once a day (409 not_paused / already_resumed; the team's cap still applies). In a team room or the everyone room: its owners and admins who are in it; in a 1:1 or a group chat: any of its members. A member without the right gets 403, anyone not in the room 404. Audited. |
| `POST` | `/api/rooms/:id/apps/:appId/example` | Signed in | "Show an example": a sample card from the app in the room, marked as an example (5 an hour, not counted toward the cap). In a team room or the everyone room: its owners and admins who are in it; in a 1:1 or a group chat: any of its members. A member without the right gets 403, anyone not in the room 404. |
| `PUT` | `/api/rooms/:id/apps/:appId/icon` | Signed in | "Change icon" › Upload an image, for a plain Other app (400 not_other for a named service, Sentry, GitHub or Google Forms): a square PNG, JPEG or WebP of 64–512 px, up to 256 KiB, as a profile photo (SVG and animations refused; metadata cut out). It replaces an emoji. At most 20 icon changes per app and hour (429). In a team room or the everyone room: its owners and admins who are in it; in a 1:1 or a group chat: any of its members. A member without the right gets 403, anyone not in the room 404. Audited. |
| `PUT` | `/api/rooms/:id/apps/:appId/icon/emoji` | Signed in | "Change icon" › Pick an emoji, for a plain Other app (400 not_other otherwise): exactly one emoji; it replaces an image. At most 20 icon changes per app and hour (429). In a team room or the everyone room: its owners and admins who are in it; in a 1:1 or a group chat: any of its members. A member without the right gets 403, anyone not in the room 404. Audited. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/rooms/:id/apps/:appId/icon` | Signed in | "Remove icon": the app shows its name's first letter again (nothing to remove: unchanged). Counts toward the 20 icon changes per app and hour (429). In a team room or the everyone room: its owners and admins who are in it; in a 1:1 or a group chat: any of its members. A member without the right gets 403, anyone not in the room 404. Audited when there was one. |
| `GET` | `/api/rooms/:id/apps/:appId/icon` | Signed in | An app's icon image, for anyone in the room (404 otherwise, and without an image); cached for a year when ?v= is the current version. An image only: nosniff and a sandbox policy. |
| `DELETE` | `/api/rooms/:id/apps/:appId` | Signed in | Remove an app from the room: its address stops working at once, its messages stay (with its name's first letter: its icon goes with it). In a team room or the everyone room: its owners and admins who are in it; in a 1:1 or a group chat: any of its members. A member without the right gets 403, anyone not in the room 404. Audited. |

## Files shared one by one (links, Ask for access)

| Method | Path | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/api/files/link` | Signed in | The /f/<id> link of a file the caller can open (made on first use; making it never makes anyone the owner). A folder in the caller's own files, once folder sharing is on: its owner only, and only a folder that can be shared (400 folder_share_place, folder_share_disk); every other folder: 400 is_folder. |
| `GET` | `/api/files/shares` | Signed in | Who a file the caller can open is shared with, whether they may change it, and its owner. A folder in the caller's own files, once folder sharing is on: the same with kind folder, what it holds, and why it cannot be shared when it cannot (blocked); every other folder: 400 is_folder. |
| `PUT` | `/api/files/shares` | Signed in | Add or remove people and groups on a file (view only). Its owner (edit access now), or the team owner and admins for a team file; never a folder (400 is_folder), never a guest (400 unknown_subject). 403 file_share_not_owner, file_shares_off. Takes from the room sending budget (429) before the people are checked, once the file is one the caller may share. Audited; each person added gets an Activity notice. Removing people and `stop` (everyone) are always the owner's, also while members' sharing is off or without edit access, and answer with `undo`. A folder in the caller's own files (view only for the people added, files added later included): 400 folder_share_place, folder_share_disk, file_share_full; `resume` for a paused folder. |
| `POST` | `/api/files/shares/take-back` | Signed in | Take back what one AI share added, by the take-back id on its card: for 10 minutes, once, only for the person who shared. Removes only the grants that share added (never access a person had before it) and, for a folder the share made from chat files, stops that folder's sharing and deletes the folder and the copies it made (unchanged ones). 404 for an id that is unknown, someone else's, used or expired. |
| `POST` | `/api/files/shares/undo` | Signed in | Put back the people and groups a removal took off a file or folder, by the undo id that removal answered with: for 10 minutes, once, only for the person who removed them. Restores those still valid (an active member, a group that exists), dated at the undo (they had no access in between), tells nobody, takes no sending budget and does not ask the team switch; says how many it skipped. 404 for an id that is unknown, someone else's, used, expired, or older than the team owner's Remove all. |
| `POST` | `/api/files/shares/cards` | Signed in | The files of an AI share card as the caller may see them now, by link id: path, people and whether the caller may add or take people off; `gone` for anything the folder rules do not let them read or whose people they may not change. Reads only. |
| `POST` | `/api/files/shares/batch` | Signed in | Share up to 100 files with the same people and groups in one press (Find work files' step): each file as PUT /api/files/shares add (owner, team switch, 50, never a guest), the files refused listed with the server's words. One send token per 10 files, taken first (429); the people are checked only when one of the files is one the caller may share. Audited per file; each person newly given access gets one notice for the press (one push when added by name). |
| `GET` | `/api/files/shared-batch/:id` | Signed in | The files of one Share press that the caller can open now (a notice's "shared 5 files with you" list), for someone that press told; 404 otherwise. |
| `GET` | `/api/files/shared-with-me` | Signed in | Files › Shared with me: the files people shared with the caller that open for them now, newest first (by name always; through a group or the whole team only when the folder does not already let them read it). Name, who shared it and when; no path, folder or owner. Never for guests (403). A bad cursor is 400. |
| `GET` | `/api/files/shared/:id` | Signed in | What a file link shows the caller: open (name, size; a folder: kind folder and its name), no_access (nothing about the file or folder), trashed (its owner only) or unknown. |
| `GET` | `/api/files/shared/:id/download` | Signed in | The current bytes of a file by its link, for someone it opens for (checked on every request); 404 otherwise. No versions, history or text. A folder link: `sub` names the file inside it (the bytes come from the very file that was checked; 429 as the listing); `sub` on a file link is 404. |
| `GET` | `/api/files/shared/:id/list` | Signed in | One level of a shared folder by its link, for someone it opens for (checked on every request): names, sizes and modified times, folders first, 200 a page. Never hidden names, links, anything above the shared folder, versions or text. 404 otherwise; 429 above 240 list, entry and download calls a minute. |
| `GET` | `/api/files/shared/:id/entry` | Signed in | One file inside a shared folder by the link and its path inside the folder: name, size and type. 404 when the link or the path does not open for the caller; 429 as the listing. |
| `POST` | `/api/files/shared/:id/request` | Signed in | Ask the file's owner (or, with none, the team owner and admins) to open it. One waiting request per person and file; 5 a day to one owner and 20 an hour in all (429). Not for guests, nor for a member's file while members' file sharing is off (403 file_request_off); unknown links 404. |
| `POST` | `/api/files/shared/:id/ask-for` | Signed in | Ask the file's owner (or, with none, the team owner and admins) to share it with these people, view only (the Share dialog's "Ask <owner>"; the same request as the "Ask <owner>" step under an AI answer). For someone who can open the file and may not share it (409 file_request_can_share when they may); never for a guest; people who are guests, not active or can open it already are skipped. One request per person, answered with the owner's Share / Decline; the same budget as a request (429). 403 file_request_off when nobody can be asked; 404 for a link the caller cannot open. |
| `POST` | `/api/files/requests/:id` | Signed in | Share or Decline on an access request (whoever may share the file now). A request already answered keeps its answer; the file gone: closed. |
| `POST` | `/api/share-fixes/:id/run` | Signed in | Run the next step the server offered under one of my AI steps (Step.fixes): "Let them view" shares the files with exactly the people the offer listed who are still in the room, active, no guests and still unable to open them (the Share dialog's own checks as me, via ai, audited); "Ask <owner>" sends the owner the access request for them; "Ask an admin" sends my 1:1 message about the folder to the team owner and admins. Once; only for the person the offer was made for (404 otherwise). Answers what it became: done (how many people, and how many in the room still cannot open it and were not listed), or gone (nothing left to do). A refusal of the action (403 file_share_not_owner, 429) leaves the offer open. |
| `GET` | `/api/files/granted-link` | Signed in | The /f/<id> link id of the file at a team path when it opens for the caller through a file share and not through the folder (a path link in a room message, opened by someone the file was shared with); id null for everything else, a missing path and a file they may not open alike. |
| `GET` | `/api/admin/file-shares` | Admin | How many files and folders are shared one by one and with how many people (the team owner's Remove all). |
| `DELETE` | `/api/admin/file-shares` | Admin | The team owner removes every file and folder share and waiting request at once (403 owner_only for admins); removals made before it can no longer be undone. Audited with the counts. |

## Ask for access to a chat or project

| Method | Path | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `GET` | `/api/chats/:id/file-access` | Signed in | In a shared chat that I see (shared with people, or a shared project chat): what I can do about a file link of the chat that does not open for me. ask (a chat shared with people made it in its creator's own folder; only the creator can add it), asked (my ask waits), copy (the chat has it now: its file id); view (another team file linked in a message I see, by someone who can read it: I may ask to view it; by: who answers, only when that is the person who linked it), viewAsked (that ask waits), open (it opens for me now; link: its /f/ link when only a share lets me in) or no, the one answer for every other case (never whether the path exists, whose it is or where). At most 60 a minute (429). Anyone who cannot see the chat: its 404. |
| `POST` | `/api/chats/:id/file-access` | Signed in | For a path file-access answers ask for: ask the creator of a chat shared with people to add a file the chat made in their own folder to the chat (an access.requested notice in their Activity; Add to the chat runs the Share step's check again). For one it answers view for: a file access request (its owner, or with none the team owner and admins, answer with Share or Decline in Activity). Else 404, the same for every reason; one waiting ask per person and file; the access requests' limits (429). open: the chat has it now, or the file opens for me (link: its /f/ link). |
| `GET` | `/api/link-access/:kind/:id` | Signed in | :kind is chat or project (else 400). What a chat or project link offers the caller when it does not open: open (it does now), no_access (canAsk, askedAt; nothing about the chat or project) or unknown. 403 for guests. |
| `POST` | `/api/link-access/:kind/:id/request` | Signed in | Ask to open a chat (its creator answers) or a team project (whoever changes its members). One waiting request per person and target; the file requests' limits, counted together (429). 403 for guests and where no request is possible (access_request_off); unknown 404; someone it opens for gets open. |
| `POST` | `/api/access-requests/:id` | Signed in | Share or Decline on a chat or project access request (whoever may share it now). Share adds the asker by name (a chat's first share answers confirm with the check first). A request already answered keeps its answer; the chat or project gone: closed. 404 for anyone it did not go to. |

## Names of links to things in this app (chips in messages)

| Method | Path | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/api/link-names` | Signed in | Names for links to things in this app pasted into messages (chats, projects, rooms, file links, folders and files), as the caller: a name only when the caller could open it now with the page's own check; no access and not there both answer name null. At most 50 per request; names only, never paths. |

## Problem reports to the Trina AX team (Settings › About, 👎 under an answer)

| Method | Path | Who | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|
| `POST` | `/api/problem-reports` | Signed in | Send a problem report to the team that makes this app: kept in an outbox and sent in the background, signed with this server's relay team key. Only the words, versions, platform, screen kind and, from 👎, the turn id, failure code and tool ids; the question and answer only with withConversation. 404 while the feature or the team switch is off; 429 problem_reports_limit past 5 a person or 30 a team a day; a guest: 403. |
